    |   |       |   |-- geometry -> endpointBounds / cell / version

    |   |           |   |   |   |   |-- id / position { column, row }

    |   |           |   |   |   |       `-- layout: push-right / gap

    |   |           |   |   |       |-- diagramId / revisionId: service identities
    |   |           |   |   |       |-- id / revision: local content identity
    |   |           |   |   |       |-- content: DiagramContent
    |   |           |   |   |       |   |-- revisionId / ascii / asciiSha256
    |   |           |   |   |       |   `-- structure
    |   |           |   |   |       |       |-- diagram
    |   |           |   |   |       |       `-- tree: parserVersion / rootIds
    |   |           |   |   |       |           `-- nodes[id]: parentId? / childIds
    |   |           |   |   |       |               `-- line / columns / foldRanges

    |   |           |   |   |       |       `-- corpus / domainProfileId
    |   |           |   |   |       `-- jumps?: DiagramJump[]

    |   |           |       |       `-- sourceContentId / sourceRevisionId?
    |   |           |       |-- diagramViews?               per-instance content folds
    |   |           |       |-- display: DisplayState       floating ownership tree
    |   |           |       |   |-- rootIds[] / nodes[id]: FloatingPane
    |   |           |       |   |-- shared: childIds / expansion / geometryPolicy
    |   |           |       |   |   `-- position / bounds / canvas-or-viewport space
    |   |           |       |   |-- selection: SelectionRegion

    |   |           |       |   |-- projection: ProjectedPane
    |   |           |       |   |   `-- content variants
    |   |           |       |   |       |-- call-tree: result / coverage
    |   |           |       |   |       |-- compaction: files[]
    |   |           |       |   |       |-- source-code: sourceFile / files / rangeIndex

    |       |-- DefaultCanvasHistoryService: WeakMap<handle, CanvasHistory>
    |       `-- append / navigate / fork / transfer / export / persistenceChanges
    |-- viewState: SourcePaneViewState
    |   `-- live pane scroll + cameras -> captureDisplay() / captureCamera()
    |-- persistence: WorkspacePersistence
    |   |-- onPersist + view subscriptions -> per-document records / workspace index
    |   `-- history deltas + metadata + baseline + canvas + viewport
    |       `-- RecordStorage -> WorkspaceStorage worker -> records API
    |-- transfer(copy | move)
    |   |-- pause persistence; verify source checkpoint; prepare source/destination
    |   `-- save proposed workspace -> install; workspace undo reverses transfer
    |-- useAgentCanvasBridge() -> { canvasId, agentStatus }
    |   `-- commands -> page handler -> controller; live selections -> publisher
    `-- mounted document views
